assets.content:
Subject: From rough idea to interactive flow
Preview text: Turn one prompt or screenshot into a prototype stakeholders can examine.

Turn a rough idea into an interactive flow

Hi there,

Turn one proposed feature or internal-tool flow into something interactive for stakeholders to examine. Give Balsamiq AI a rough prompt or screenshot, then develop the wireframe into an interactive prototype without writing code.

Balsamiq is a wireframing and prototyping tool for taking ideas beyond static descriptions. The prototype gives reviewers something concrete to explore before the proposed flow becomes engineering work.

Use the 14-day trial to test one real flow and decide whether the result represents what you mean. No credit card is required.

Try Balsamiq free for 14 days → https://balsamiq.cloud/#signup

- Balsamiq

partial_caveats_injected: Trial is 14 days, no credit card required; continued use requires a per-editor annual plan from $16/month (Starter)
A project is the unit of work and is capped per plan; boards inside it are unlimited and free
AI use draws on monthly AI credits per editor (500 on Starter, about 31 wireframes or 10 prototypes)
Invited reviewers can view or comment only, not edit
Do not promise: Any growth, signup or conversion result (the SparkToro 20% figure is one customer's reported outcome with no stated period or method, not a promise)
Do not promise: Zero disruption to the team's existing design workflow or tools
Do not promise: Reduced headcount, reduced design hours or quantified time or cost savings
Do not promise: Superiority over or replacement of Figma, Whimsical, Draw.io or any incumbent tool
Do not promise: A guarantee of stakeholder alignment or recorded sign-off
Do not promise: Unlimited AI capacity or unlimited projects
This is a documented-use draft, not proof of the broader audience hypothesis or recipient fit.
